mapper.select: UPDATE public.department_admin_invitation_outbox SET status = 'PROCESSING', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, claim_version = claim_version + 1, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY') AND next_attempt_at <= #{now} RETURNING id, account_id, department_id, issued_by_account_id, (SELECT name FROM public.department WHERE id = department_id) AS department_name, recipient_email, delivery_type, attempt_count, claim_version, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.department AS department JOIN public.account_department_role AS role_assignment ON role_assignment.department_id = department.id AND role_assignment.account_id = department_admin_invitation_outbox.account_id AND role_assignment.role = 'DEPARTMENT_ADMIN' AND role_assignment.revoked_at IS NULL JOIN public.account AS account ON account.id = department_admin_invitation_outbox.account_id WHERE department.id = department_admin_invitation_outbox.department_id AND department.active AND ((department_admin_invitation_outbox.delivery_type = 'INVITATION' AND account.status = 'PENDING_SETUP') OR (department_admin_invitation_outbox.delivery_type = 'ROLE_ASSIGNED' AND account.status = 'ACTIVE')) ) AS eligible
mapper.update: UPDATE public.department_admin_invitation_outbox AS outbox SET status = 'PENDING', attempt_count = 0, next_attempt_at = #{now}, lease_until = NULL, last_error_code = NULL, updated_at = #{now} FROM public.department AS department WHERE outbox.id = #{id} AND outbox.department_id = #{departmentId} AND department.id = outbox.department_id AND department.active AND outbox.status = 'DEAD'
